episodes.synopsis: While returning from a late-night tryst, Lord Narihira and his entourage encounter an oxcart traveling toward them — but there's no ox pulling the cart.
episodes.title: The Traveling Demon

episodes.synopsis: After a demon offers him the chance to embrace a woman of "peerless beauty," a lecherous lord comes before Seimei in need of help.
episodes.title: The Head Minister

episodes.synopsis: Saying a winged mouse sent her, an elderly servant asks Seimei for help; little Kujo and Lady Fujiko have begun to behave very strangely.
episodes.title: Ashiya Doman

episodes.synopsis: The revengeful spirit of a deceased poet named Tadami has been haunting the area. He's been mostly harmless — until now.
episodes.title: A Rumor of Love

episodes.synopsis: When speaking to Tadami's father, Seimei and Hiromasa find out that Tadami had an encounter with a demon years before succumbing to his death.
episodes.title: Are You Lovesick?

episodes.synopsis: Lord Tachibana consults with Ashiya Doman to cure his daughter of her love of insects, but Seimei is skeptical of her remedy.
episodes.title: The Lady Who Loved Insects

episodes.synopsis: Hiromasa brings a basket of mushrooms to enjoy with Seimei, whom he finds completely engrossed in identifying some dead green insects.
episodes.title: Liveliness

episodes.synopsis: While watching over Seimei, Hiromasa sees visions of his dear friend's childhood and the torment he endured for being so different and gifted.
episodes.title: The Fox's Child

episodes.synopsis: Lady Tsuyuko suspects an unlikely person of being the half demon. Seimei faces off against Ashiya Doman to see who the better Onmyoji is.
episodes.title: A Contest of Magic at the Imperial Court

episodes.synopsis: Much to everyone's annoyance, Seimei has been visiting members of the imperial court in the middle of the night in search of the demon who attacked him.
episodes.title: A Lost Curse

episodes.synopsis: A drastic — and revealing — change comes over Atsumi. As Seimei struggles to accept recent events, Yasunori brings him an object that gives him hope.
episodes.title: Metamorphosis

episodes.synopsis: With Ashiya Doman's assistance, Seimei begins the Lord Taizan Ceremony. The familiar sound of a flute rings out.
episodes.title: The Lord Taizan Ceremony

episodes.synopsis: As dark forces consume Atsumi, he has flashbacks to the long and enduring friendship he shared with Hiromasa.
episodes.title: The Demon Within
